dedupe_keys.name: dtpm travel matrices of santiago public transport trips stages boardings and alightings

description: The Metropolitan Public Transport Directorate (DTPM) of Santiago, Chile, publishes travel matrices for the city's public transport (Red buses, Metro and train). The tables are built by processing the GPS positions of the bus fleet together with fare card use (bip! cards and other payment media). The page offers, for the latest time cut, a trips table in which each row is a trip by one person with estimated boarding and alighting points for each stage, a stages table, and boarding and alighting data, with files describing fields and structures; the representative time of a trip is its start time. Coverage: the Santiago public transport system. Format and access: downloadable database files without registration. Licence and cost: free; no licence is stated. Caveats: destinations are inferred, not observed, and the page is in Spanish. It supports network flow, capacity planning and agent-based demand models. It relates to the GTFS specification and the Istanbul hourly ridership data in the catalogue.
